recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if the work group wants a broader statement about context conduction or independent access in documents/messages, which would be outside the narrow FHIR-17033 change.
issue_request: FHIR-17033 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 clarification for FHIR-core-Feed asking the Bundle Boundaries and Relationships sentence to say resources may have independent existence, since document or message resources might not be independently REST-addressable.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 14393, represented by Git commit 42bf1cc54758d0827fefec7124969a2b3be546e4, which changed source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml from resources that have independent existence to resources that can have independent existence and changed the example clause to say they might also be REST-accessed.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists bundle=Bundle in the active [resources] section, so source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml is in current build scope. Later history has not reversed this wording. Community searches found no direct FHIR-17033 Zulip or Confluence record that conflicts with the source conclusion; one 2023 Zulip thread quoted the current sentence as applicable Bundle guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current 'can have ... might also' wording already conveys the optionality requested by the Jira, so replacing it with the exact word 'may' would be editorial churn rather than a needed current-spec correction.
